page.layout: One page of running text, one column, with no margin notes. Page number at top left. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: Martyris, in laudatione S. Ioannis Dama-
scenì [?]. Cyrillus Scythopolitanus in vita Ioan-
Sabæ. Daniel Monachus in vita Ioannis Climaci.
Demetrius Chrysolora Orat. de S. Demetrio.
tatu de animabus separatis. Gabriel Hy-
mnodus Can. in S. Nicolaum . Gabriel Se-
Georgius Grammaticus Orat. in SS. Barba-
sanctum Georgium Martyrem, Orat. in S. Dio-
nysium Areopagitam, Orat. in S. Marinam
Martyrem, Orat. in S. Euthymium Mady-
torum Episcopum, In vita S. Lazari Gale-
in Palamam. Gregorius Abbas in Oxia Ins-
rius, in laudatione S. Demetrij Martyris.

page.notes: Long s was normalised to plain s (Tranflatione, Conftantinus, Eustratius, separatis). The "ct" ligature is read as "ct". The word after "Dama-" is partly unclear, so "Damascenì" is marked [?]. Show-through from the facing page appears along the right edge and is not transcribed. The catchword "Gre-" is at the right below the last line.
